propositions: On final exhaustion of the prompted reask loop in _pai_structured, when llm.parse_failure_artifact_dir is set to a non-empty path, write a timestamped artifact file containing the last raw reply, model id, contract name, and attempt count before raising the parse error.
The new llm.parse_failure_artifact_dir config key is resolved on LLMConfig via _llm_str in from_env (not on core config), with environment alias REBAR_LLM_PARSE_FAILURE_ARTIFACT_DIR and default None.
The artifact write is best-effort and never masks the original parse error; I/O failures (missing dir, permissions, full disk) are swallowed and the parse error is raised unchanged.
The artifact directory is created if absent; oldest-by-mtime artifacts are pruned to keep at most 20 per directory after each write to prevent unbounded growth.
A successful parse takes the return path and writes no artifact; the hook runs only on final failure in the prompted branch.
